egress.terms: Your server. Free of platform metering; you pay the host.

tooling: Mattermost REST API v4 `POST /api/v4/files` (multipart, up to 10 files per post) returning file IDs. Team Edition is MIT-licensed; Entry is the free mode of Enterprise Edition.
chaining: N self-hosted deployments; 10,000 teams per deployment; users per team 'no enforced limit'. Storage is whatever disk you mount — including an S3/MinIO backend via FileSettings.

limits.value: per-file ceiling is configurable: default 100 MB

limits_note: 100 MB per attachment default (configurable), 10 attachments per post, 16,383-char messages. Entry caps message history at 10,000 channel messages across all channels and 1,000 Board cards.

reliability_note: Zero platform risk — nothing can delete your files. The failure mode is operational: attachments live on the app server's local disk unless you configure S3, and the docs warn that raising MaxFileSize risks server crashes on large uploads.
